title: The Dolphins’ Secret Corridor
moral: True leadership comes from listening and learning from others.

scenes.summary: Captain Mira finds a map and begins a new journey.
scenes.text: Captain Mira discovered an old map showing a path through dangerous reefs, and she decided to follow it with her crew.

scenes.summary: The crew enters the dangerous Grumpy Reefs.
scenes.text: The ship sailed into dark waters filled with hidden rocks, making the journey risky.

scenes.summary: Dolphins guide the ship safely through the reefs.
scenes.text: Dolphins appeared and showed the crew a safe path, and Mira carefully followed them.

scenes.summary: Mira learns to trust the dolphins and her crew.
scenes.text: Mira realized she needed to listen and trust others to guide the ship safely.

story: Captain Mira sailed with her crew on the Sea Sprout when she found a map leading through the Grumpy Reefs. The journey was dangerous, but dolphins appeared and guided them safely. Mira trusted their guidance and led her crew carefully through the narrow path. They reached calm waters, and Mira learned that true leadership comes from listening, humility, and teamwork. The crew sailed forward, stronger and wiser.
